WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS "orders.region_net_total"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS "orders.net_total"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.customers.tier",
  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.net_total",
  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.region_net_total"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
  AND _base."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.tier"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC,
  _base."orders.customers.tier" ASC
LIMIT 100

args.message: Net total per region and tier: the sum over orders of the order amount minus the ordering customer's discount. Each row also shows the region's overall net total. I left out orders with no customer. Customers with no known region are grouped under a null region; all of them are silver tier. The discount is subtracted as a flat amount once per order, not as a percentage. No amounts or discounts were missing among the 5,010 orders included.
